query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleDate,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as dateUTC,
  DATE(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) as dateBrazil
FROM sales s
WHERE s.id IN (15000025, 15000046)
ORDER BY s.id;
